mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits brivaracetam metabolism via CYP2C19 and UGT, increasing brivaracetam plasma concentrations, while brivaracetam may modestly increase valproate levels through competitive metabolism.
action: Monitor brivaracetam levels and clinical effects; consider brivaracetam dose reduction when combined with valproate; monitor for increased CNS adverse effects and valproate toxicity signs.
